newsitem.title: UK: Banco Safra, Unibanco plan dollar Eurobonds - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Banco Safra, Unibanco plan dollar Eurobonds - dealers.

text.p: Brazilian banks Banco Safra and Unibanco plan to issue dollar Eurobonds in January, syndicate managers said on Wednesday.

Banco Safra could bring a $200 million eight-year bond with three- and five-year puts. Spread talk was 225 basis points over U.S. Treasury notes. Bear Stearns and UBS were tipped as joint lead managers.
Unibanco was planning a smaller $100 million transaction. Spread talk was 190 b.p. over, and SBC Warburg was the likely lead manager, dealers said.
A slew of Brazilian Eurobonds were launched on Wednesday from Banco Bradesco, Banco Cidade and BNDES. Also in the pipeline is a $200 million deal for Ford Brazil.

The issue will have a 10-year maturity with puts in years six and eight. Spread talk is around 275 b.p. over Treasuries, and joint lead managers are ABN AMRO Hoare Govett and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell.
"Demand for Latin American paper is strong," said a syndicate manager at a U.S. bank.
"The search for yield continues, with an increasing amount of cross-over buying. This means investors who used to buy only AAA and AA credits are buying more sub-investment grade paper," he said.
